access_principles.confidential_access: Department-aware restrictions govern CONFIDENTIAL documents. Users may access CONFIDENTIAL materials belonging to their designated or authorized departments.
access_principles.restricted_access: Explicit individual authorization or administrator elevation is strictly required for RESTRICTED documents. Implicit access is not granted.

roles.description: Standard workforce member across any business unit.
roles.notes: Access limited to public documents and internal enterprise-wide general communications.

roles.description: People or functional manager leading teams within an operational unit.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access to relevant CONFIDENTIAL documents pertaining to team management, budgeting, and assigned operational departments.

roles.notes: Permitted access to management-tier internal and department-relevant confidential records.

roles.description: Software, platform, or infrastructure development professional.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access restricted specifically to Engineering CONFIDENTIAL technical specifications, architecture blueprints, and development runbooks.

roles.notes: Department-scoped confidential access restricted to technical and engineering systems.

roles.description: Machine learning, LLM systems, and data platform specialist.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access to relevant AI & Data CONFIDENTIAL documents and relevant AI Governance CONFIDENTIAL documents (e.g. model cards, risk evaluations, and data pipelines).

roles.notes: Cross-departmental access for technical AI data and governance oversight.

roles.description: Cybersecurity, risk assessment, and infrastructure protection engineer.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access to relevant Information Security CONFIDENTIAL documents, vulnerability assessments, and infrastructure security controls.

roles.notes: Authorized for Information Security confidential materials and explicitly authorized restricted security documentation.

roles.description: Operational leader managing business continuity, cloud reliability, and facilities.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access to relevant Operations CONFIDENTIAL runbooks, vendor contracts, disaster recovery protocols, and operational budget allocations.

roles.notes: Department-scoped confidential access focusing on business and IT operations.

roles.description: People operations leader directing talent, compensation, and employee relations.

confidential_access.scope_condition: Access to relevant Human Resources CONFIDENTIAL documents including compensation scales, disciplinary records, and talent reviews.

roles.notes: Strictly scoped confidential access to human resources and personnel documents.

roles.description: Enterprise administrator holding root administrative authority and compliance oversight.
roles.notes: Full administrative read capability across all enterprise classifications and departments.
